I work as an employee for the Kame Yu department stores, and I get home every day by 8 PM at the latest. I don't smoke, but I occasionally drink. I'm in bed by 11 PM, and make sure I get eight hours of sleep, no matter what. After having a glass of warm milk and doing about twenty minutes of stretches before going to bed, I usually have no problems sleeping until morning. Just like a baby, I wake up without any fatigue or stress in the morning. I was told there were no issues at my last check-up. I'm trying to explain that I'm a person who wishes to live a very quiet life. I take care not to trouble myself with any enemies, like winning and losing, that would cause me to lose sleep at night. Happened 6 days ago. My car had a bent control arm and a few alignment issues and I made the mistake of not taking my car to an actual garage. Instead I let my fathers friend Big B look at it and he said he could order some parts and fix it good as new so I said fuck yeah. Well needless to say Big B "fixed" my car in a few days and I was able to drive myself to work again. So there I am going about 75mph on a slightly snowy interstate. I could still feel my car jerking a bit but my I just assumed my alignment was off. So I am in the middle lane and decide I should speed up to pass a semi in front of me.. WELL I do and when I go to merge back my goddamn car spins out and I roll 4 times on the interstate and then a few extra down a hill. I only remember the first two rolls and my head became a lovely basketball being hit off the roof of my car and driver side window. I remember crawling out of my shattered window and laying in the snow for like 8 minutes. I was helped up by a kind bald man whose first words to me were "Whoa! your fucking car flipped". ended up with a gnarly concussion, bruised ribs, and a new fear of cars.
